name: Road Kill
source:
What happens when a Ska band gets caught up in the zombie apocalypse while on tour? 

Road Kill is a story about a cast of weirdos trying to survive and make their way home to their families. They'll face obstacles like zombies (of course!), crazed corporate military agents, mutated undead monsters, horrifying super-soldier experiments, and fanatical cults along the way.  

You play as Jethro Fixler, the bassist and former vocalist of ROAD KILL!

How will your decisions effect the lives of your friends? How will the skills of those closest to you help keep you alive as you make your way from New Mexico, back home to Boston? Who will live and who will die? 

[From [url=https://lithiuminteractive.itch.io/road-kill]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当斯卡乐队在巡演时陷入僵尸末日时会发生什么？

《Road Kill》讲述了一群怪人试图生存并回家与家人团聚的故事。他们一路上会遇到僵尸（当然！）、疯狂的企业军事特工、变异的不死怪物、可怕的超级士兵实验和狂热的邪教等障碍。

你扮演Jethro Fixler，ROAD KILL的贝斯手和前主唱！

你的决定将如何影响你朋友的生活？当你从新墨西哥州返回波士顿的途中，你最亲近的人的技能将如何帮助你维持生命？谁会活，谁会死？

[来自[url=https://lithiuminteractive.itch.io/road-kill]Itch.io[/url]]
